market_summary: Overall market exhibits mixed momentum across asset classes during late London session. US100 remains in a clean upward trend above VWAP and EMA50 with strong CVD support. Gold (XAUUSD) continues to display weakness below key baselines and POC, presenting a clear sell opportunity. Currencies (EURUSD, GBPUSD) are hovering near session lows without clear volume expansion, while BTCUSD displays order flow divergence near resistance, suggesting selective trading.

signals.rationale: Price is inside the Value Area (VAL 4040.14 to VAH 4059.52) and below POC 4044.58. CVD is BEARISH (-1.54) with a negative slope (-0.63), supporting downward momentum during the LONDON_SESSION. Price is currently trading below VWAP (4048.59) and EMA50 (4050.08), approaching the lower ATR band (4039.53). RVOL is average (0.969) without recent yellow spikes. Having rejected S/R at 4052.38, the path of least resistance points toward Session Low at 4026.41.

Price is inside the Value Area (VAL 1.11315 to VAH 1.11606) and below POC 1.11374. CVD is NEUTRAL (-1264) despite a slightly positive slope (+278.76). During LONDON_SESSION, price remains trapped near the lower ATR band (1.11315) and below both VWAP (1.11504) and EMA50 (1.11512). Volume is low (RVOL 0.639). Due to compression right above Session Low support at 1.11307 without an RVOL breakout trigger, edge is insufficient.

Price is below VAL (1.33177) and below POC (1.33473). CVD is NEUTRAL (-518) with a rising slope (+355.89) indicating fading selling pressure near support. In LONDON_SESSION, price is trading below VWAP (1.33299) and EMA50 (1.33319) near the lower ATR band (1.33082). Volume is moderate (RVOL 0.892). Price is pressing against Prev Low (1.33119) and Session Low (1.3307), showing signs of exhaustion/sweeps without clean trend expansion. Prefer to HOLD.

Price is inside the Value Area (VAL 28060.92 to VAH 28302.45) and well above POC 28121.30. CVD is BULLISH (+9.32) with positive slope (+0.36), confirming buyers are in control during LONDON_SESSION. Price holds strong above VWAP (28102.87) and EMA50 (28116.21), floating near the upper ATR band (28303.43). As per US100 tick volume characteristics, absence of yellow RVOL bars is expected; structural alignment is strongly bullish. Live price offers a minor pullback from Session High 28302.45 for a momentum buy.

Price is above VAH (73867.86) and above POC (73660.40). However, CVD is BEARISH (-0.05) with negative slope (-0.01), showing divergence against the price push higher in LONDON_SESSION. Price sits above VWAP (73682.43) and EMA50 (73746.15), mid-channel under upper ATR band (74232.30). RVOL is average (1.038) with no breakout spikes. Rejection at S/R 73975.30 combined with CVD divergence signals potential trap above VAH.
